history.subject: War of the Worlds radio broadcast, Sun 30 Oct 1938, CBS, Mercury Theatre on the Air (unsponsored, 17 weeks on air), Orson Welles aged 23; adapted H.G. Wells' novel as fake news bulletins about Martians landing in New Jersey (Smithsonian). Some listeners frightened, called police/newspapers; next morning newspapers reported nationwide panic, stampedes, suicides (Smithsonian). C.E. Hooper phoned 5,000 households that night: only 2% named the Welles program/a radio play; it aired against the popular Chase and Sanborn Hour (Edgar Bergen). Six NYC hospitals had no cases; no verified suicide. Newspapers had lost ad revenue to radio and used the story to paint radio as untrustworthy (Slate, Pooley & Socolow 2013; NPR 2013).

facts.subject: Göygöl formed after the 30 (or 25) Sept 1139 Ganja earthquake (M ~7+): part of Mount Kapaz collapsed and the landslide dammed a mountain river (Kürəkçay per Wikipedia, Ağsu per azerbaijan.travel) -> lake; 7 lakes formed in total incl. Maralgöl and Ağgöl (Wikipedia '1139 Ganja earthquake'). Altitude ~1,556 m, max depth ~93-96 m, area 0.78 km² (Wikipedia Göygöl). Goy Gol reserve 1925, national park 2008. Nizami Ganjavi born c. 1141 in Ganja (Britannica/Wikipedia).

facts.subject: Jan Koum: emigrated from a village near Kyiv, Ukraine, to Mountain View, California at 16 with his mother; mother babysat, he swept a grocery store; they stood in line for food stamps at a government office in Mountain View (J Weekly 2014; NBC). Brian Acton rejected by Facebook in 2009 (NBC). Facebook bought WhatsApp for $19 bn (Feb 2014); Koum (37), Acton and Sequoia's Jim Goetz signed it at the disused former North County Social Services office across the tracks from WhatsApp HQ, where Koum once stood in line for food stamps (Forbes via ACM; Quartz; J Weekly).

facts.subject: Kola Superdeep Borehole SG-3, Kola Peninsula (Murmansk region, Russia): drilling began May 1970, reached 12,262 m (40,230 ft) in 1989, deepest artificial point; diameter ~23 cm (9 in); bottom temperature ~180 °C vs ~100 °C expected; rock behaved 'more like plastic', drilling stopped 1992, project ended 1994 (Scientific American; EarthDate/UT Austin). Welded shut (photo Aug 2012). Everest 8,849 m -> hole is ~3.4 km deeper than Everest is high.

facts.caption:
İnsanın qazdığı ən dərin quyu 12 262 metrdir 🕳️

1970-ci ildə sovet alimləri Kola yarımadasında Yerin qabığını öyrənmək üçün quyu qazmağa başladılar. 1989-cu ildə quyu 12 262 metrə çatdı: bu, Everest dağının hündürlüyündən 3 km-dən çoxdur. Amma quyunun eni cəmi 23 santimetrdir. Dibdə istilik 180 dərəcəyə çatdı, alimlər isə təxminən 100 dərəcə gözləyirdilər. İstidən qaya yumşaldı, qazma alətləri sıradan çıxdı və iş 1992-ci ildə dayandırıldı. İndi quyunun ağzı metal qapaqla bağlanıb.

facts.subject: SN 1054: on 4 July 1054 Chinese (and Japanese) astronomers recorded a 'guest star' in Taurus, said to be as bright as the Moon; visible in daylight for 23 days and at night for nearly two years (~653 days per Sung Shih) (EARTH Magazine; EarthSky). Its remnant is the Crab Nebula (M1), ~6,500 light-years away; central pulsar spins ~30 times per second (EarthSky; EARTH Magazine).
